sentences.en: Our dog Rex used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
sentences.zh: 我们的狗雷克斯过去常常蹲在大门外叫。

sentences.en: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
sentences.zh: 雷克斯很快就成了开门的能手。

article.en: Our dog Rex used to sit outside our front gate and bark.
article.zh: 我们的狗雷克斯过去常常蹲在大门外叫。

article.en: Every time he wanted to come into the garden, he would bark until someone opened the gate.
article.zh: 每当它想进花园时，就会一直叫，直到有人把门打开。

article.en: As the neighbours complained of the noise, my husband spent weeks training him to press his paw on the latch to let himself in.
article.zh: 因为邻居们抱怨狗叫太吵，我丈夫花了好几个星期训练它用爪子按门闩自己开门进去。

article.en: Rex soon became an expert at opening the gate.
article.zh: 雷克斯很快就成了开门的能手。

article.en: However, when I was going out shopping last week, I noticed him in the garden near the gate.
article.zh: 然而，上周我出去买东西时，发现它在花园里靠近大门的地方。

article.en: This time he was barking so that someone would let him out!
article.zh: 这一次它叫着，好让人放它出去！

article.en: Since then, he has developed another bad habit.
article.zh: 从那以后，它又养成了一个坏习惯。

article.en: As soon as he opens the gate from the outside, he comes into the garden and waits until the gate shuts.
article.zh: 它从外面一打开门，就进到花园里，等着门关上。

article.en: Then he sits and barks until someone lets him out.
article.zh: 然后它蹲在那儿叫，直到有人放它出去。

article.en: Yesterday my husband removed the gate and Rex got so annoyed we have not seen him since.
article.zh: 昨天我丈夫把门拆了，雷克斯气坏了，从那以后我们再没见过它。
